notes.subject: הרפו
notes.rationale: 'Let go/desist' (JPS 'Let be', YLT 'Desist') vs the traditional 'Be still' (KJV); avañeʼẽ 'pekangy' keeps the slackening sense.

notes.subject: ארום...ארום
notes.rationale: Repetition of 'I am/will be exalted' frames the verse; preserved by repeating 'ahetáta'.

notes.subject: to the congregation
notes.rationale: Twin imperatives 'Pekangy, ha peikuaa' directly summon the hearer.

notes.subject: to Israel
notes.rationale: Direct address in the plural imperative; God speaks as אנכי Elohim.

translation: Pekangy, ha peikuaa che haʼeha Elohim; ahetáta tetãnguéra apytépe, ahetáta yvy ape ári.
